title: Feedforward network: transform each token
source_copy: Desktop copy, 19-slide revision inspected on October 10, 2026 (Asia/Shanghai)
adaptation: Native token columns, affine maps, and activation; distinguish the 2017 ReLU from the GPT-2 GELU. Dropout omitted.

steps.label: Expand the feature width using the same first affine map at every token.
Apply the activation to each hidden coordinate. The 2017 model uses ReLU; GPT-2 uses GELU.
Project back to the model width. The FFN preserves batch and token axes.
